# US-004: See and act on Action Required

## User Story

As a Client, I want to see what is waiting for my review and open it, so that I respond on time.

## Context

ACTION REQUIRED (L194–L231).

Phase 2 (quote P2) — build after Phase 1 acceptance.

## Acceptance Criteria

### AC-001 — Pending items listed

- **Type:** happy-path
- **Covers:** FR-dashboard-tasks-009
- **Screen:** home

```gherkin
Given round 2 of "711" has 3 timecoded comments to review (item source TBD)
When Home opens
Then Action Required lists "Video Round 2" with project, area, description and due date-time
And the count reads "{n} Pending Reviews"
```

### AC-002 — Review Now

- **Type:** happy-path
- **Covers:** FR-dashboard-tasks-010
- **Screen:** home

```gherkin
Given item "Video Round 2"
When the user presses "Review Now"
Then Video Review of round 2 opens (target rule TBD)
```

### AC-003 — Nothing pending

- **Type:** error-path
- **Covers:** FR-dashboard-tasks-009
- **Screen:** home-empty
- **Error code:** E-dashboard-tasks-002

```gherkin
Given no item awaits review
When Home opens
Then E-dashboard-tasks-002 is shown (wording TBD)
```
